subject: District Strategic Plan Review
overview: The Communication, Stakeholder Engagement & Strategic Planning Subcommittee met to review the draft District Strategy for Improvement presented by district administrators. Following a detailed presentation and discussion on the plan's key focus areas, the subcommittee voted to forward the report to the full School Committee.

items.title: Review of Draft Strategic Plan
items.summary: District administrators presented the updated draft District Strategy for Improvement covering achievement, collaboration, equity, and support, and the subcommittee voted to forward the report to the full School Committee.
